authors: B. A. Kniehl, V. N. Velizhanin
title: Nonplanar four-loop anomalous dimensions of twist-two operators in N=4 super Yang-Mills theory: higher moment, general result, and cusp anomalous dimension
journal: Phys. Rev. D111 (2025) L061902 (DOI listed on abstract page)
claim: Direct diagrammatic computation of the non-planar four-loop twist-two universal anomalous dimension extended to Lorentz spin j = 20; this fixes the previously conjectured general-j result without extra analytic assumptions; the large-j limit re-derives the non-planar four-loop cusp anomalous dimension.
scheme: direct diagrammatic calculation (scheme not stated on abstract page; component DRED machinery inherited from 0808.3832 assumed)
symmetry_argument: none stated on the abstract page

assumed: component DR adequate at four loops for spin up to 20 operators
checked_partially: large-j limit reproduces the non-planar four-loop cusp anomalous dimension obtained independently from form factors (Henn-Korchemsky-Mistlberger 1911.10174; Huber et al. 1912.13459) - a non-trivial DR-vs-DR cross-check across different observables

evidence: Abstract (paraphrased): spin 20, general result, cusp re-derived
red_flags: general-j formula obtained by fitting an ansatz to finite moments (number theory/LLL-type reconstruction), although now with fewer assumptions
cross_checks: non-planar four-loop cusp from Sudakov form factor computations (arXiv:1911.10174, 1912.13459)
notes: Highest-spin four-loop non-planar DR-type computation in N=4 found; shows the component DRED toolchain is still used for N=4 operator renormalization at four loops in 2024-2025.
